instruction: Configure GIMP to use 500 MiB for the tile cache size.

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate to GIMP preferences and set the tile cache size to 500 MiB. The evaluator checks the gimprc config file for 'tile-cache-size 500m'. Uses existing check_config_status metric and get_gimp_config_file getter.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 1.0 if tile-cache-size is set to 500m, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Critical expected value format mismatch: The gimprc file stores values with quotes (e.g., '(tile-cache-size "500m")'), but the expected value is '500m' without quotes
The check_config_status metric parses lines by splitting and compares items[-1] which will be '"500m"' (with quotes) against the expected '500m' (without quotes), causing the check to always fail
The evaluator logic is otherwise correct: proper postconfig to close GIMP, correct getter to retrieve gimprc file, and appropriate metric function
The instruction coverage is complete - only one requirement (tile cache size) needs to be checked
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change the expected value from '500m' to '"500m"' (with escaped quotes) to match the gimprc file format
Alternatively, modify the check_config_status metric to strip quotes from values before comparison (e.g., items[-1].strip('"'))
Test with actual gimprc file content to verify the exact format and quote handling
